changes.before: Bear, sex can be what you do when you’re older and find a friend you love in a super special way that makes you want to raise children together. Don’t imagine you love each other just because you want each other. Don’t feel pressure to promise what your heart will feel. Let the love and bond it produces blossom in its own time as your hearts sync. Learn about each other before getting too close, and make sure to keep friends and community around who know both of you.
